rules.statement: The cause of action for damages arises from the failure to execute a conveyance free from encumbrances, as evidenced by the Secretary's conveyance dated October 25, 1946.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my view the contention on behalf of the plaintiffs that their rights must be determined in relation to P5 and not to the decree is sound. It has been argued that having regard to section200 of the Civil Procedure Code and the judgment of Wijeyewardene, J., in Karthigesu et al1 [ 1 (1945) 46 N. L. R. 162. ] . v. Parupathy et all a conveyance is not necessary to vest title in a pre-emptor who is successful in his suit."
